title: Bidara brings biomimicry into the conversation
summary:
A biomimicry guide joined the models, tool support became easier to check, and the community project list got a tidy-up.

Added `bidara`, a text-and-image persona that guides users through a biomimicry design process, pauses for feedback between steps, and asks for peer-reviewed citations. The same PR also made Google Cloud authentication failures return cleanly instead of throwing.

The `/models` endpoint now includes a `tools` capability flag, so developers can check which listed models support tool calls. This improves capability reporting; it does not change tool-calling behavior.

Define, a REST API for generating definitions with controls for length, tone, context, and language, was added to the README and website listings. PrivatePollenAI was removed from both at its owner's request.

highlights.title: Meet Bidara
highlights.text: Work through a biomimicry design problem with `bidara`, a text-and-image persona that asks for feedback between steps and requests peer-reviewed citations. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=bidara).

highlights.title: Check model tool support
highlights.text: The `/models` endpoint now reports a `tools` flag, so you can check tool-call support before choosing a model. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
